## (1) Remaining science questions and required variants

Governing clauses are the **P0 binding locals** only. P2–P7 Context/Location/E0 work stays later.

### Branch A — profiles / references / TPO / shape (unanswered)

**M04 / SR-M04.** Keep the full POC maximizer set and a named tie-selected scalar. Required variants: value **17/25 (68%)** and **7/10 (70%)**; POC tie lower vs upper; VA expansion tie lower / upper / both; one-tick origin-0 vs widths 2/4/8 × origins 0/1; triangular scales 1/2/4; raw mass vs normalized shape; overflow and unpriced retained. **Do not** run the full `profile_catalogue` Cartesian on every cut.

**M04.ANCHORS.** Distinct clock profiles: prior/developing cash RTH, observed 18:00–17:00 futures, overnight, 06:00–09:00, calendar day/week/month (completed only). Rolling and **causal swing/event/composite** wait for confirmed structure (Branch B). A retrospective geometric start publishes at `selection_known_at`, not at the geometric start.

**M04.PROXY.** Same dates/anchors: exact trade histogram vs `BAR_PROXIES` (`equal_inclusive_rows`, `continuous_overlap`, `pin066_source`, `pin066_corrected`, `close`, `hlc3`). First wave: exact cells + **one** named proxy (`pin066_corrected` or `equal_inclusive_rows`). Missing tape → unavailable or tagged proxy, never synthetic tails.

**M04.TOPOLOGY.** `local_peaks` / `interior_valleys` / `dominance_margin` / `maximum_plateaus` from `profile_geometry_rows`. Prominence across smoothing ≠ persistence across time. A one-tick grid shift must not invent a shelf.

**M05 / SR-M05.** Buy / sell / unknown / signed / abs-delta stay separate. Signed delta is **not** a probability. Unknown-side interval vs sign-certified concentration. Same grid as M04.

**M06 / SR-M06.** Three estimands: (i) **trade-visit TPO** from occupied cells, brackets **15/30/60**; (ii) **bar-range occupancy** from atom high/low; (iii) **executed dwell** and **displayed-quote occupancy** (`TimeAtPrice`) — block (iii) where quote/dwell inputs are missing; do not drop (i)–(ii). Keep provisional vs final single prints; IB; tails; naked = untouched since confirmed birth. Legacy “five-bracket display-ready” is a flag, not the scientific final-print rule (kernel: ≥2 complete brackets).

**M07 / SR-M07.** Atoms already have VWAP, variance, weighted q05–q95. Still needed: **anchor-scoped** VWAP (RTH / 18–17 / 06–09 / developing prefix), rolling downdate, zero-mass, robust quantile vs SD/percent bands. A band is not a calibrated path interval.

**M12 / SR-M12.** First observed print ≠ certified open; official settlement ≠ last close. Each reference keeps type, economic date, `known_at`. **Official settlement is blocked** until a publication vintage exists (same class of gap as scheduled-event2). Observed opens/closes/gaps from atoms + Jumbo timing tables remain eligible.

**C07 / SR-C07.** Descriptive axes only: dwell/volume outside value; **frozen-at-birth VA** vs developing VA; boundary-motion vs price crossing; brief wick vs sustained trade; no-progress high volume; no-event / no-contact / failed repair. **Not** HMM/Context fit.

**C08 / SR-C08.** Same raw tick grid; separate total-mass growth, normalized shape, coordinate drift, missing-support. `shape_distance` only if both views have complete coverage and zero overflow/unpriced; else null. Future POC/VA from **added mass on a grid frozen at the cut**, never from the completed-session profile. Shared input mass across overlapping anchors must be stated.

**M13.** Optional cheap add-on on the **same cells** (`footprint_geometry`). Not a third study. Stacked/diagonal thresholds stay declared; no absorption/iceberg label.

### Branch B — cohorts / structure / memory (unanswered; different input)

**M02.FIXED_COHORT** is closed at the **atomic/core** grain (true OHLC, occupancy). Still open: **M02.ADAPT_COHORT / UP-M02** train-only equal-count, equal-volume, top-35%, and soft overlapping weights; thresholds frozen at stage close (NQ train 2020–2022; ES train 2020 only); never rebucket old events. `TradeSizeHistogram` / `fit_unpublished_cohort_definition` exist; no full-population table.

**M08 / SR-M08.** Confirm pivots/DCs only when the rule is observable. Freeze the threshold **at leg birth**; a volatility-updating threshold is a separate detector. Keep equal-extreme ties and nested-leg rules. First wave: **2–3 disclosed fixed tick DCs** + **one bar-pivot length pair × two tie rules** — not the probe’s 5×2×4 Cartesian. Multiscale tree, FVG, order/rejection blocks: later. Unconfirmed points stay provisional.

**M11 / SR-M11.** Birth every eligible cluster **before** outcome. Freeze membership at the cut. Time vs volume decay are separate; **visit decay is unsupported** in the current kernel (`_VISIT`). Protection, retest, matured markout are **labels**, not birth selectors. Future favorable markout must not choose the object. First wave: time-box and volume-half-life on complete-history windows only; volume-clock decay unavailable if the relevant window has missing history.

**R-pattern prefixes** (absorption, POC flip, retest/failure) become observable only after A+B prefixes exist. Not this study’s completion target.

### What existing evidence already answers

Hard-cohort CVD/OHLC and occupancy; minute POC **count** and side concentration; VWAP **moments at the atom**; source-alias equality; coordinate/coverage gates; causal formation/label **clocks and path outcomes**; scheduled-event **calendar** (925 events) for later joins. None of that is VA, HVN/LVN, TPO, migration, adaptive cohorts, confirmed structure, or memory.
